items.source: If there is a single static factory method annotated with @PersistenceCreator then it is used.
items.translation: 如果存在一个带有@PersistenceCreator注解的单个静态工厂方法，则使用该方法。

items.source: If there are multiple constructors and exactly one is annotated with @PersistenceCreator, it is used.
items.translation: 如果存在多个构造函数且其中恰好有一个被标注为@PersistenceCreator，则使用该构造函数。

items.source: If the type is a Java Record the canonical constructor is used.
items.translation: 如果类型是 Java 的Record，则使用规范构造函数。

items.source: Which property should be persisted (default to all declared properties)? You can exclude properties by annotating these with @Transient.
items.translation: 应持久化哪些属性（默认为所有声明的属性）？ 您可以通过使用 @Transient 注解来排除某些属性。

items.source:
Spring Data automatically tries to detect a persistent entity’s constructor to be used to materialize objects of that type.
The resolution algorithm works as follows:
items.translation:
Spring Data 会自动尝试检测持久化实体中用于实例化该类型对象的构造函数。
解析算法的工作方式如下：

items.source: If there is a single constructor, it is used.
items.translation: 如果有单个构造函数，则使用它。

items.source:
If there’s a no-argument constructor, it is used.
Other constructors will be ignored.
items.translation:
如果有无参构造函数，则使用它。  
其他构造函数将被忽略。

items.source: Both classes define a field using assignable types. SubType however shadows SuperType.field. Depending on the class design, using the constructor could be the only default approach to set SuperType.field. Alternatively, calling super.setField(…) in the setter could set the field in SuperType. All these mechanisms create conflicts to some degree because the properties share the same name yet might represent two distinct values. Spring Data skips super-type properties if types are not assignable. That is, the type of the overridden property must be assignable to its super-type property type to be registered as override, otherwise the super-type property is considered transient. We generally recommend using distinct property names.
items.translation: 两个类都使用可赋值类型定义了 `field`。然而，`SubType` 会遮蔽 `SuperType.field`。 根据类的设计，使用构造函数可能是设置 `SuperType.field` 的唯一默认方式。 或者，在 setter 中调用 `super.setField(…)` 也可以设置 `SuperType` 中的 `field`。 所有这些机制在某种程度上都会产生冲突，因为属性名称相同，但可能代表两个不同的值。 如果类型不可赋值，Spring Data 会跳过超类型的属性。 也就是说，被覆盖属性的类型必须可赋值于其超类型属性类型才能注册为覆盖属性；否则，超类型属性将被视为瞬态。 我们通常建议使用不同的属性名称。

items.source: Getters and setters on SubType set only SubType.field and not SuperType.field. In such an arrangement, using the constructor is the only default approach to set SuperType.field. Adding a method to SubType to set SuperType.field via this.SuperType.field = … is possible but falls outside of supported conventions. Property overrides create conflicts to some degree because the properties share the same name yet might represent two distinct values. We generally recommend using distinct property names.
items.translation: SubType 上的 getter 和 setter 仅设置 SubType.field，而不会设置 SuperType.field。 在这种安排下，使用构造函数是设置 SuperType.field 的唯一默认方法。 虽然可以通过在 SubType 中添加一个方法来通过 this.SuperType.field = … 设置 SuperType.field，但这不符合支持的习惯用法。 属性覆盖会在一定程度上产生冲突，因为这些属性具有相同的名称，但可能代表两个不同的值。 我们通常建议使用不同的属性名称。

items.source: Embedded entities are used to design value objects in your Java domain model whose properties are flattened out into the table. In the following example you see, that User.name is annotated with @Embedded. The consequence of this is that all properties of UserName are folded into the user table which consists of 3 columns (user_id, firstname, lastname).
items.translation: 嵌入式实体用于在 Java 领域模型中设计值对象，其属性会被扁平化到表中。 在下例中可以看到，User.name 被标注了 @Embedded。 这一后果是，UserName 的所有属性都被折叠到 user 表中，该表包含三列（user_id、firstname、lastname）。

items.source: @Value: This annotation is part of the Spring Framework . Within the mapping framework it can be applied to constructor arguments. This lets you use a Spring Expression Language statement to transform a key’s value retrieved in the database before it is used to construct a domain object. In order to reference a property of a given Row/UdtValue/TupleValue one has to use expressions like: @Value("#root.getString(0)") where root refers to the root of the given document.
items.translation: @Value：此注解属于 Spring 框架。在映射框架中，它可以应用于构造函数参数。 这使得您可以使用 Spring 表达式语言语句，在利用该值构建领域对象之前，对从数据库中检索到的键值进行转换。 若要引用给定 Row/UdtValue/TupleValue 的属性，则需使用类似 @Value("#root.getString(0)") 的表达式，其中 root 指代给定文档的根节点。

items.source: Make use of the shortcuts @Embedded.Nullable and @Embedded.Empty for @Embedded(onEmpty = USE_NULL) and @Embedded(onEmpty = USE_EMPTY) to reduce verbosity and simultaneously set JSR-305 @javax.annotation.Nonnull accordingly.
items.translation: 使用快捷方式@Embedded.Nullable和@Embedded.Empty来替代@Embedded(onEmpty = USE_NULL)和@Embedded(onEmpty = USE_EMPTY)，以减少冗长性，同时相应地设置 JSR-305 注解@javax.annotation.Nonnull。

items.source: Every time the name parameter is either not part of the result or its value is null, then the name defaults to unknown.
items.translation: 每次 `name` 参数不在结果中或其值为 `null` 时，`name` 将默认为 `unknown`。

items.source: AbstractCassandraConfiguration requires you to implement methods that define a keyspace. AbstractCassandraConfiguration also has a method named getEntityBasePackages(…). You can override it to tell the converter where to scan for classes annotated with the @Table annotation.
items.translation: `AbstractCassandraConfiguration` 要求您实现用于定义 keyspace 的方法。 `AbstractCassandraConfiguration` 还提供了一个名为 `getEntityBasePackages(…)` 的方法。您可以重写该方法，以告知转换器扫描带有 `@Table` 注解的类的位置。

items.source: A primary key class is a composite primary key class that is mapped to multiple fields or properties of the entity. It is annotated with @PrimaryKeyClass and should define equals and hashCode methods. The semantics of value equality for these methods should be consistent with the database equality for the database types to which the key is mapped. Primary key classes can be used with repositories (as the Id type) and to represent an entity’s identity in a single complex object. The following example shows a composite primary key class:
items.translation: 主键类是一种复合主键类，它映射到实体的多个字段或属性。 该类需使用 @PrimaryKeyClass 注解进行标记，并应定义 equals 和 hashCode 方法。 这些方法的值相等语义应与所映射数据库类型的数据库相等性保持一致。 主键类可用于仓库（作为 Id 类型），也可用于在单个复杂对象中表示实体的身份。 以下示例展示了一个复合主键类：

items.source: You can configure a SASI Index to apply an analyzer, such as StandardAnalyzer or NonTokenizingAnalyzer (by using @StandardAnalyzed and @NonTokenizingAnalyzed, respectively).
items.translation: 您可以配置一个 SASI 索引以应用分析器，例如 `StandardAnalyzer` 或 `NonTokenizingAnalyzer`（分别使用 `@StandardAnalyzed` 和 `@NonTokenizingAnalyzed`）。

items.source: Unless explicitly configured, an instance of MappingCassandraConverter is created by default when creating a CassandraTemplate. You can create your own instance of the MappingCassandraConverter to tell it where to scan the classpath at startup for your domain classes to extract metadata and construct indexes.
items.translation: 除非显式配置，否则在创建 CassandraTemplate 时默认会生成一个 MappingCassandraConverter 实例。 您可以自行创建 MappingCassandraConverter 的实例，以便在启动时指定类路径扫描位置，从而提取域类的元数据并构建索引。

items.source: You can annotate particular entity properties with @Indexed, @SaiIndexed, or @SASI if you wish to create secondary indexes on application startup. Index creation creates simple secondary indexes for scalar types, user-defined types, and collection types.
items.translation: 您可以使用 `@Indexed`、`@SaiIndexed` 或 `@SASI` 注解特定实体属性，以便在应用程序启动时创建二级索引。 索引创建会为标量类型、用户定义类型和集合类型生成简单的二级索引。

items.translation: 映射类型区分了 `ENTRY`、`KEYS` 和 `VALUES` 索引。 索引的创建会根据注解的元素推导出索引类型。 以下示例展示了创建索引的多种方式：

items.source: Rich object mapping support is provided by the MappingCassandraConverter. MappingCassandraConverter has a rich metadata model that provides a complete feature set of functionality to map domain objects to CQL tables.
items.translation: MappingCassandraConverter 提供了丰富的对象映射支持。MappingCassandraConverter 拥有完善的元数据模型，能够完整实现将领域对象映射到 CQL 表的功能。

items.source: If the property is immutable but exposes a with… method (see below), we use the with… method to create a new entity instance with the new property value.
items.translation: 如果该属性是不可变的，但暴露了 `with…` 方法（见下文），我们使用 `with…` 方法来创建具有新属性值的新实体实例。

items.source: Use factory methods instead of overloaded constructors to avoid @PersistenceCreator — With an all-argument constructor needed for optimal performance, we usually want to expose more application use case specific constructors that omit things like auto-generated identifiers etc. It’s an established pattern to rather use static factory methods to expose these variants of the all-args constructor.
items.translation: 使用工厂方法而非重载构造函数，以避免使用 @PersistenceCreator——由于全参构造函数对于最佳性能是必需的，我们通常希望暴露更多针对特定应用程序用例的构造函数，这些构造函数会省略诸如自动生成的标识符等内容。 采用静态工厂方法来暴露全参构造函数的各种变体，是一种成熟的模式。

items.source: For identifiers to be generated, still use a final field in combination with an all-arguments persistence constructor (preferred) or a with… method —
items.translation: 若要生成标识符，仍需使用最终字段配合全参数持久化构造函数（首选）或 with… 方法 —

items.source: Use Lombok to avoid boilerplate code — As persistence operations usually require a constructor taking all arguments, their declaration becomes a tedious repetition of boilerplate parameter to field assignments that can best be avoided by using Lombok’s @AllArgsConstructor.
items.translation: 使用 Lombok 避免样板代码——由于持久化操作通常需要包含所有参数的构造函数，其声明往往变成对样板式参数到字段赋值语句的繁琐重复，而使用 Lombok 的 @AllArgsConstructor 可以最好地避免这种情况。

items.source: Each supported type maps to a default Cassandra data type. Java types can be mapped to other Cassandra types by using @CassandraType, as the following example shows:
items.translation: 每个支持的类型都映射到默认的 Cassandra 数据类型。 可以使用 @CassandraType 将 Java 类型映射到其他 Cassandra 类型，如下例所示：

items.source: The simple (short) Java class name is mapped to the table name by being changed to lower case. For example, com.bigbank.SavingsAccount maps to a table named savingsaccount.
items.translation: 简单的（短的）Java 类名通过转换为小写映射到表名。例如，com.bigbank.SavingsAccount 映射为名为 savingsaccount 的表。

items.source: You can adjust conventions by configuring a NamingStrategy on CassandraMappingContext. Naming strategy objects implement the convention by which a table, column or user-defined type is derived from an entity class and from an actual property.
items.translation: 您可以通过在 CassandraMappingContext 上配置一个 NamingStrategy 来调整约定。命名策略对象定义了从实体类以及实际属性派生表、列或用户定义类型的约定方式。

items.source: You can add additional converters to the MappingCassandraConverter by overriding the customConversions method.
items.translation: 您可以通过重写customConversions方法向MappingCassandraConverter添加额外的转换器。

items.source: To take full advantage of the object mapping functionality inside the Spring Data for Apache Cassandra support, you should annotate your mapped domain objects with the @Table annotation. Doing so lets the classpath scanner find and pre-process your domain objects to extract the necessary metadata. Only annotated entities are used to perform schema actions. In the worst case, a SchemaAction.RECREATE_DROP_UNUSED operation drops your tables, and you lose your data. Note that tables are accessed from the session keyspace. You can however specify a custom keyspace to use a table/UDT from a specific keyspace.
items.translation: 要充分利用 Spring Data for Apache Cassandra 支持中的对象映射功能，您应该使用 @Table 注解来标记您的映射域对象。 这样做可以让类路径扫描器找到并预处理您的域对象，以提取必要的元数据。 只有经过注解的实体才会用于执行模式操作。 在最坏的情况下，SchemaAction.RECREATE_DROP_UNUSED 操作会删除您的表，从而导致数据丢失。 请注意，表是从会话的键空间中访问的。 不过，您可以指定一个自定义的键空间，以从特定的键空间中访问表/UDT。

items.source: Flat composite primary keys are embedded inside the entity as flat fields. Primary key fields are annotated with @PrimaryKeyColumn. Selection requires either a query to contain predicates for the individual fields or the use of MapId. The following example shows a class with a flat composite primary key:
items.translation: 扁平复合主键作为平铺字段嵌入实体中。 主键字段需使用@PrimaryKeyColumn注解进行标注。 查询时，必须包含针对各个字段的谓词条件，或使用MapId。 以下示例展示了一个具有扁平复合主键的类：

items.source: You can embed a value object multiple times in an entity by using the optional prefix element of the @Embedded annotation. This element represents a prefix and is prepended to each column name in the embedded object. Note that properties will overwrite each other if multiple properties render to the same column name.
items.translation: 您可以使用 `@Embedded` 注解的可选 `prefix` 元素，在实体中多次嵌入值对象。该元素表示一个前缀，并将附加到嵌入式对象的每个列名之前。请注意，如果多个属性映射到相同的列名，则后定义的属性将覆盖先前的属性。

items.source: @PrimaryKey: Similar to @Id but lets you specify the column name.
items.translation: @PrimaryKey：与@Id类似，但允许您指定列名。

items.source: @PrimaryKeyColumn: Cassandra-specific annotation for primary key columns that lets you specify primary key column attributes, such as for clustered or partitioned. Can be used on single and multiple attributes to indicate either a single or a composite (compound) primary key. If used on a property within the entity, make sure to apply the @Id annotation as well.
items.translation: @PrimaryKeyColumn：Cassandra 专用的主键列注解，允许您指定主键列的属性（例如用于聚簇或分区）。 该注解可应用于单个或多个属性，以表示单一主键或复合（组合）主键。 如果将其用于实体内的属性，请确保同时应用 @Id 注解。

items.source: @PrimaryKeyClass: Applied at the class level to indicate that this class is a compound primary key class. Must be referenced with @PrimaryKey in the entity class.
items.translation: @PrimaryKeyClass：在类级别应用，表示该类为复合主键类。必须在实体类中与@PrimaryKey一起引用。

items.source: @Frozen: Applied at the field level to class-types and parametrized types. Declares a frozen UDT column or frozen collection like List<@Frozen UserDefinedPersonType>.
items.translation: @Frozen：在字段级别应用于类类型和参数化类型。声明冻结的 UDT 列或冻结集合，例如 List<@Frozen UserDefinedPersonType>。

items.source: @Version: Applied at field level is used for optimistic locking and checked for modification on save operations. The initial value is zero which is bumped automatically on every update.
items.translation: @Version：在字段级别应用，用于乐观锁，并在保存操作时检查修改。初始值为zero，每次更新时会自动递增。

items.source: The @Indexed annotation can be applied to single properties of embedded entities or along with the @Embedded annotation, in which case all properties of the embedded are indexed.
items.translation: @Indexed 注解可以应用于嵌入实体的单个属性，也可以与 @Embedded 注解一起使用，在这种情况下，嵌入实体的所有属性都会被索引。

items.source: The mapping metadata model is populated by using annotations on your domain objects. However, the infrastructure is not limited to using annotations as the only source of metadata. The MappingCassandraConverter also lets you map domain objects to tables without providing any additional metadata, by following a set of conventions.
items.translation:
映射元数据模型是通过在域对象上使用注解来填充的。  
然而，基础设施并不局限于仅使用注解作为元数据的唯一来源。  
`MappingCassandraConverter` 还允许您遵循一组约定，将域对象映射到表，而无需提供任何额外的元数据。

items.source: In this chapter, we describe the features of the MappingCassandraConverter, how to use conventions for mapping domain objects to tables, and how to override those conventions with annotation-based mapping metadata.
items.translation: 在本章中，我们将介绍 `MappingCassandraConverter` 的特性，如何使用约定将领域对象映射到表，以及如何通过基于注解的映射元数据覆盖这些约定。

items.source: The value resolution assumes constructor/factory method argument names to match the property names of the entity, i.e. the resolution will be performed as if the property was to be populated, including all customizations in mapping (different datastore column or field name etc.). This also requires either parameter names information available in the class file or an @ConstructorProperties annotation being present on the constructor.
items.translation: 值解析假定构造函数/工厂方法的参数名称与实体属性名称相匹配，即解析过程将如同该属性正在被填充一样执行，包括所有映射自定义（如不同的数据存储列或字段名等）。 此外，还要求类文件中提供参数名称信息，或者在构造函数上存在 `@ConstructorProperties` 注解。

items.source: The value resolution can be customized by using Spring Framework’s @Value value annotation using a store-specific SpEL expression. Please consult the section on store specific mappings for further details.
items.translation: 可以通过使用 Spring Framework 的 `@Value` 注解及特定于存储库的 SpEL 表达式来自定义值解析。有关更多详细信息，请参阅关于存储库特定映射的部分。

items.source: If the property is immutable we’re using the constructor to be used by persistence operations (see Object creation) to create a copy of the instance.
items.translation: 如果属性是不可变的，我们将使用构造函数（参见对象创建）来为持久化操作创建该实例的副本。

items.source: Similarly to our optimizations in object construction we also use Spring Data runtime generated accessor classes to interact with the entity instance.
items.translation: 与我们在对象构建中的优化类似，我们也使用 Spring Data 运行时生成的访问器类来与实体实例进行交互。

items.source: Types must not reside in the default or under the java package.
items.translation: 类型不得位于默认包或java 包下。

items.source: Types and their constructors must be public
items.translation: 类型及其构造函数必须是public的。

items.source: Types that are inner classes must be static.
items.translation: 作为内部类的类型，必须是static的。

items.source: The used Java Runtime must allow for declaring classes in the originating ClassLoader. Java 9 and newer impose certain limitations.
items.translation: 所使用的 Java 运行时必须允许在源 `ClassLoader` 中声明类。Java 9 及更高版本施加了某些限制。

items.source: Try to stick to immutable objects — Immutable objects are straightforward to create as materializing an object is then a matter of calling its constructor only. Also, this avoids littering your domain objects with setter methods that allow client code to manipulate the object’s state. If you need those, prefer to make them package protected so that they can only be invoked by a limited amount of co-located types. Constructor-only materialization is up to 30% faster than properties population.
items.translation: 尽量使用不可变对象——创建不可变对象非常简单，只需调用其构造函数即可完成对象的实例化。 此外，这还能避免在领域对象中散布允许客户端代码操纵对象状态的 setter 方法。 如果确实需要这些方法，建议将其设为包级私有（package protected），以便仅由有限的同包类型调用。 仅通过构造函数创建对象的速度比通过属性赋值快高达 30%。

items.source: Provide an all-args constructor — Even if you cannot or don’t want to model your entities as immutable values, there’s still value in providing a constructor that takes all properties of the entity as arguments, including the mutable ones, as this allows the object mapping to skip the property population for optimal performance.
items.translation: 提供一个全参构造函数——即使您无法或不愿将实体建模为不可变值，提供接受实体所有属性（包括可变属性）作为参数的构造函数仍然具有价值，因为这允许对象映射跳过属性填充过程，从而实现最佳性能。

items.source: Make sure you adhere to the constraints that allow the generated instantiator and property accessor classes to be used —
items.translation: 确保遵守相关约束，以便生成的实例化器和属性访问器类能够被使用。

items.source: Using @AccessType(PROPERTY) cannot be used as the super-property cannot be generally set without making any further assumptions of the setter implementation.
items.translation: 使用@AccessType(PROPERTY)不可行，因为无法在不对 setter 实现做出任何额外假设的情况下设置超属性。

items.source: If there is a constructor that is annotated with @PersistenceCreator, it is used.
items.translation: 如果存在一个带有@PersistenceCreator注解的构造函数，则使用它。

items.source: If the type is a Kotlin data class the primary constructor is used.
items.translation: 如果类型是Kotlin 数据类，则使用主构造函数。

items.source: Cassandra requires at least one partition key field for a CQL table. A table can additionally declare one or more clustering key fields. When your CQL table has a composite primary key, you must create a @PrimaryKeyClass to define the structure of the composite primary key. In this context, “composite primary key” means one or more partition columns optionally combined with one or more clustering columns.
items.translation: Cassandra 要求 CQL 表至少包含一个分区键字段。 表还可以声明一个或多个聚类键字段。 当您的 CQL 表具有复合主键时，必须创建一个 `@PrimaryKeyClass` 来定义复合主键的结构。 在此上下文中，“复合主键”指一个或多个分区列与一个或多个聚类列的组合（可选）。

items.source: By using @PrimaryKeyClass.
items.translation: 通过使用@PrimaryKeyClass。

items.source: The MappingCassandraConverter can use metadata to drive the mapping of objects to rows in a Cassandra table. An overview of the annotations follows:
items.translation: MappingCassandraConverter 可以利用元数据来驱动对象到 Cassandra 表中行的映射。以下是对这些注解的概述：

items.source: @Id: Applied at the field or property level to mark the property used for identity purposes.
items.translation: @Id：应用于字段或属性级别，用于标记用于标识目的的属性。

items.source: @Table: Applied at the class level to indicate that this class is a candidate for mapping to the database. You can specify the name of the table where the object is stored. When specifying the keyspace, the table name will be prefixed with the keyspace for all DML and DDL operations.

@Transient: By default, all private fields are mapped to the row. This annotation excludes the field where it is applied from being stored in the database. Transient properties cannot be used within a persistence constructor as the converter cannot materialize a value for the constructor argument.
items.translation: @Transient：默认情况下，所有私有字段都会映射到行中。此注解会排除应用该注解的字段，使其不被存储到数据库中。瞬态属性不能在持久化构造函数中使用，因为转换器无法为构造函数参数生成值。

items.source: @PersistenceConstructor: Marks a given constructor — even a package protected one — to use when instantiating the object from the database. Constructor arguments are mapped by name to the key values in the retrieved row.
items.translation:
@PersistenceConstructor：标记一个给定的构造函数（即使是包级私有的），用于从数据库实例化对象。  
构造函数的参数通过名称映射到检索行中的键值。

items.source: @ReadOnlyProperty: Applies at the field level to mark a property as read-only. Entity-bound insert and update statements do not include this property.
items.translation: @ReadOnlyProperty：在字段级别应用，用于将属性标记为只读。 绑定到实体的插入和更新语句不包含此属性。

items.source: @Column: Applied at the field level. Describes the column name as it is represented in the Cassandra table, thus letting the name differ from the field name of the class. Can be used on constructor arguments to customize the column name during constructor creation.

@Embedded: Applied at the field level. Enables embedded object usage for types mapped to a table or a user-defined type. Properties of the embedded object are flattened into the structure of its parent.
items.translation: @Embedded：应用于字段级别。 使映射到表或用户定义类型的类型能够使用嵌入对象。 嵌入对象的属性被扁平化并合并到其父结构的结构中。

items.source: @Indexed: Applied at the field level. Describes the index to be created at session initialization.
items.translation: @Indexed：应用于字段级别。 描述在会话初始化时创建的索引。

items.source: @SASI: Applied at the field level. Allows SASI index creation during session initialization.
items.translation: @SASI：在字段级别应用。 允许在会话初始化期间创建 SASI 索引。

items.source: @SaiIndexed: Applied at the field level. Allows to define SAI (storage-attached indexes) index creation during session initialization.
items.translation: @SaiIndexed：在字段级别应用。 允许在会话初始化期间定义存储附加索引（SAI）的创建。

items.source: @CassandraType: Applied at the field level to specify a Cassandra data type. Types are derived from the property declaration by default.
items.translation: @CassandraType：应用于字段级别，用于指定 Cassandra 数据类型。默认情况下，类型由属性声明推导得出。

items.source: @VectorType: Applied at the field level to specify the Cassandra vector type. This annotation is required when using schema generation.
items.translation: @VectorType：在字段级别应用，用于指定 Cassandra 向量类型。 在使用模式生成时，此注解是必需的。

items.source: @UserDefinedType: Applied at the type level to specify a Cassandra User-defined Data Type (UDT). When specifying the keyspace, the UDT name will be prefixed with the keyspace for all DML and DDL operations. Types are derived from the declaration by default.
items.translation: @UserDefinedType：在类型级别应用，用于指定 Cassandra 用户定义类型（UDT）。 在指定键空间时，所有 DML 和 DDL 操作中的 UDT 名称都将以前缀形式包含该键空间。 默认情况下，类型由声明推导得出。

items.source: @Tuple: Applied at the type level to use a type as a mapped tuple.
items.translation: @Tuple：在类型级别应用，用于将类型用作映射元组。

items.source: @Element: Applied at the field level to specify element or field ordinals within a mapped tuple. Types are derived from the property declaration by default. Can be used on constructor arguments to customize tuple element ordinals during constructor creation.
items.translation: @Element：应用于字段级别，用于指定映射元组中的元素或字段序数。 类型默认由属性声明推导得出。 也可用于构造函数参数，以在创建构造函数时自定义元组元素的序数。

items.source:
This section covers the fundamentals of Spring Data object mapping, object creation, field and property access, mutability and immutability.
Note, that this section only applies to Spring Data modules that do not use the object mapping of the underlying data store (like JPA).
Also be sure to consult the store-specific sections for store-specific object mapping, like indexes, customizing column or field names or the like.
items.translation: 本节涵盖 Spring Data 对象映射、对象创建、字段和属性访问以及可变性与不可变性的基础知识。请注意，本节仅适用于不使用底层数据存储（如 JPA）的对象映射的 Spring Data 模块。此外，请务必查阅针对特定存储的章节，以了解特定于存储的对象映射内容，例如索引、自定义列或字段名称等。

items.source:
Core responsibility of the Spring Data object mapping is to create instances of domain objects and map the store-native data structures onto those.
This means we need two fundamental steps:
items.translation:
Spring Data 对象映射的核心职责是创建领域对象实例，并将存储原生的数据结构映射到这些对象上。
这意味着我们需要两个基本步骤：

items.source: Instance creation by using one of the constructors exposed.
items.translation: 通过暴露的构造函数之一创建实例。

items.source: Instance population to materialize all exposed properties.
items.translation: 实例化以具象化所有已公开的属性。

items.source:
To avoid the overhead of reflection, Spring Data object creation uses a factory class generated at runtime by default, which will call the domain classes constructor directly.
I.e. for this example type:
items.translation:
为避免反射带来的开销，Spring Data 默认使用在运行时生成的工厂类来创建对象，该工厂类将直接调用领域类的构造函数。
即对于此示例类型：

items.translation: 我们将在运行时创建一个语义上与此类等效的工厂类：

items.source:
This gives us a roundabout 10% performance boost over reflection.
For the domain class to be eligible for such optimization, it needs to adhere to a set of constraints:
items.translation:
这为我们带来了比反射大约 10% 的性能提升。  
要使领域类符合此类优化的条件，它需要遵守一组约束：

items.source: it must not be a private class
items.translation: 它不能是私有类。

items.source: it must not be a non-static inner class
items.translation: 它不能是非静态内部类。

items.source: it must not be a CGLib proxy class
items.translation: 它不能是 CGLib 代理类。

items.source: the constructor to be used by Spring Data must not be private
items.translation: Spring Data 所使用的构造函数不能是私有的。

items.source: If any of these criteria match, Spring Data will fall back to entity instantiation via reflection.
items.translation: 如果满足上述任一条件，Spring Data 将通过反射回退到实体实例化。

items.source:
Once an instance of the entity has been created, Spring Data populates all remaining persistent properties of that class.
Unless already populated by the entity’s constructor (i.e. consumed through its constructor argument list), the identifier property will be populated first to allow the resolution of cyclic object references.
After that, all non-transient properties that have not already been populated by the constructor are set on the entity instance.
For that we use the following algorithm:
items.translation:
一旦创建了该实体的实例，Spring Data 将填充该类中所有剩余的持久化属性。  
除非这些属性已由实体构造函数填充（即通过构造函数参数列表传入），否则标识符属性将被首先填充，以便解析循环对象引用。  
随后，所有未被构造函数填充的非瞬态属性将被设置到实体实例上。  
为此，我们采用以下算法：

items.source: If property access (i.e. access through getters and setters) is defined, we’re invoking the setter method.
items.translation: 如果定义了属性访问（即通过 getter 和 setter 进行访问），我们将调用 setter 方法。

items.source: If the property is mutable we set the field directly.
items.translation: 如果该属性是可变的，则直接设置该字段。

items.source: By default, we set the field value directly.
items.translation: 默认情况下，我们直接设置字段值。

items.source:

items.source: 1 The identifier property is final but set to null in the constructor. The class exposes a withId(…) method that’s used to set the identifier, e.g. when an instance is inserted into the datastore and an identifier has been generated. The original Person instance stays unchanged as a new one is created. The same pattern is usually applied for other properties that are store managed but might have to be changed for persistence operations. The wither method is optional as the persistence constructor (see 6) is effectively a copy constructor and setting the property will be translated into creating a fresh instance with the new identifier value applied. 2 The firstname and lastname properties are ordinary immutable properties potentially exposed through getters. 3 The age property is an immutable but derived one from the birthday property. With the design shown, the database value will trump the defaulting as Spring Data uses the only declared constructor. Even if the intent is that the calculation should be preferred, it’s important that this constructor also takes age as parameter (to potentially ignore it) as otherwise the property population step will attempt to set the age field and fail due to it being immutable and no with… method being present. 4 The comment property is mutable and is populated by setting its field directly. 5 The remarks property is mutable and is populated by invoking the setter method. 6 The summary property transient and will not be persisted as it is annotated with @Transient. Spring Data doesn’t use Java’s transient keyword to exclude properties from being persisted as transient is part of the Java Serialization Framework. Note that this property can be used with a persistence constructor, but its value will default to null (or the respective primitive initial value if the property type was a primitive one). 7 The class exposes a factory method and a constructor for object creation. The core idea here is to use factory methods instead of additional constructors to avoid the need for constructor disambiguation through @PersistenceCreator. Instead, defaulting of properties is handled within the factory method. If you want Spring Data to use the factory method for object instantiation, annotate it with @PersistenceCreator.
items.translation: 1 标识符属性为 final 类型，但在构造函数中被设置为 null。该类提供了一个 withId(…) 方法用于设置标识符，例如当实例被插入数据存储且已生成标识符时。原始的 Person 实例保持不变，因为会创建一个新的实例。通常会对其他需要存储管理但可能需要更改以进行持久化操作的属性应用相同的模式。wither 方法是可选的，因为持久化构造函数（见第 6 点）本质上是一个拷贝构造函数，设置该属性将被转换为创建一个新实例，并将新的标识符值应用其中。 2 firstname 和 lastname 属性是普通的不可变属性，可能通过 getter 方法暴露。 3 age 属性是不可变的，但它是从 birthday 属性派生而来的。按照所示的设计，数据库值将优于默认值，因为 Spring Data 仅使用声明的构造函数。即使意图是优先采用计算结果，也重要的是该构造函数也必须接受 age 作为参数（以便可能忽略它），否则属性填充步骤将尝试设置 age 字段，但由于该字段不可变且不存在 with… 方法而失败。 4 comment 属性是可变的，通过直接设置其字段来填充。 5 remarks 属性是可变的，通过调用 setter 方法来填充。 6 summary 属性是瞬态的，不会被持久化，因为它被标注为 @Transient。Spring Data 不使用 Java 的 transient 关键字来排除属性不被持久化，因为 transient 是 Java 序列化框架的一部分。请注意，该属性可以与持久化构造函数一起使用，但其值将默认为 null（如果属性类型是基本类型，则为其相应的基本类型初始值）。 7 该类提供了一个工厂方法和一个构造函数用于对象创建。这里的核心思想是使用工厂方法而不是额外的构造函数，以避免通过 @PersistenceCreator 进行构造函数消歧的需要。相反，属性的默认值处理在工厂方法内部完成。如果您希望 Spring Data 使用工厂方法进行对象实例化，请将其标注为 @PersistenceCreator。

items.source: 1 PropertyAccessor’s hold a mutable instance of the underlying object. This is, to enable mutations of otherwise immutable properties. 2 By default, Spring Data uses field-access to read and write property values. As per visibility rules of private fields, MethodHandles are used to interact with fields. 3 The class exposes a withId(…) method that’s used to set the identifier, e.g. when an instance is inserted into the datastore and an identifier has been generated. Calling withId(…) creates a new Person object. All subsequent mutations will take place in the new instance leaving the previous untouched. 4 Using property-access allows direct method invocations without using MethodHandles.
items.translation: 1 PropertyAccessor 持有底层对象的可变实例。这是为了能够修改原本不可变的属性。 2 默认情况下，Spring Data 使用属性访问方式来读取和写入属性值。根据 private 字段的可见性规则，使用 MethodHandles 与字段进行交互。 3 该类提供了一个 withId(…) 方法，用于设置标识符，例如当实例被插入数据存储且已生成标识符时。调用 withId(…) 会创建一个新的 Person 对象。所有后续的修改都将在新实例中进行，而不会改变之前的实例。 4 使用属性访问允许直接进行方法调用，而无需使用 MethodHandles。

items.source: Delegated properties are not supported with Spring Data. The mapping metadata filters delegated properties for Kotlin Data classes. In all other cases you can exclude synthetic fields for delegated properties by annotating the property with @Transient.
items.translation: Spring Data 不支持委派属性。对于 Kotlin 数据类，映射元数据会过滤掉委派属性。 在其他所有情况下，您可以通过使用 @Transient 注解来排除委派属性的合成字段。

items.source: The @Id annotation tells the mapper which property you want to use for the Cassandra primary key. Composite primary keys can require a slightly different data model.
items.translation: @Id 注解告诉 Mapper 您希望使用哪个属性作为 Cassandra 的主键。 复合主键可能需要稍微不同的数据模型。

items.source: Non-nullable properties using non-primitive value types are flattened in the compiled class to the value type. Nullable primitive value types or nullable value-in-value types are represented with their wrapper type and that affects how value types are represented in the database.
items.translation: 使用非原始值类型的不可空属性在编译后的类中会被扁平化为值类型。 可空的原始值类型或可空的值 - 值类型将以其包装类型表示，这会影响值类型在数据库中的表示方式。

items.source: Index creation on session initialization may have a severe performance impact on application startup.
